protocol.calculation_reuse: exact-input memo within this planning call; draws and per-trial budgets unchanged
protocol.scheduling: generate each trial in draw order; distribute its screens; collect only all completed starts
protocol.generation_scope: task contact roles; one role per module; variable-count auxiliary uses same task grammar
protocol.task_contact_count_law: uniform 1..N per start, independent of nominal force feasibility
protocol.task_contact_selection: normalized task-wrench residual, then force-boundary distance with 0.5 N normal floor
protocol.task_pose_initialization: retain generated root, joints and contact targets for continuous surface fitting
protocol.probability_scope: one more trial of this fixed generator; not existence of a better structure
